opener: malten. EMERGENCY. adam posted a pic of me.

u know adam. add_me_adam. the 10,412 friends guy. he went 2 the mall sat like i told him 2 n we met irl (HES REAL (hes 6'1 n very shy)). we split a pretzel. it stormed at 4 like always n we got caught running 2 the car.

n he took a pic of me under the fountain awning n put it UP. caption says 'friend #1 (MET!!!!)'. malten my hair is FLAT. like a wet hello kitty pillow. its UNTEASED. nobody has ever seen me untouched. it has 11 comments already n under pc4pc law i have 2 comment it back.

choices.say: breathe. open the pic. tell me what you actually see, not what you're scared of.
pc4pc is your law. you comment back. so what's the first word?
didn't you owe him a pile of comments anyway? pay the whole debt tonight, loudly.

them: ok. looking. i see a girl w/ NO hair n a big dumb laugh n the fountain behind her. n the edge of adam's elbow, bc he's holding a hat for me under his arm. he bought me a bucket hat. it was a surprise. it was in a bag. its still in the bag in the pic.
i look... happy. i hate it. i look like i dont know someones looking. thats not a face i make on purpose. i dont have a name 4 that face.

choices.say: that's the best photo of you anywhere on this site. say it out loud.
read me the 11 comments. all of them. don't skip the weird ones.

them: its the one thing ive never broken. 1,184 comments, not 1 missed. ask anyone. its my first rule from when i had 12 friends. i comment back so nobody feels like me-w/-12-friends.
so if i skip adam, adam is me. n adam has 10,412 friends n has met ONE of them. so i cant skip. but i also cant type the 3 words i always type, 'cute pic!! pc4pc?', on THIS one.

choices.say: then it's easy. what would you have wanted someone to say to you when you had 12?
he commented all 47 of your pics back in august, remember? you owe him 44 more.

them: ...u remembered that. ok yeah. i have a note in my sidekick that says 'owe adam 47.' i paid 3. n u know why? he never asked. not once. he just said 'thanks 4 the add' n kept commenting. its the worst, bc u cant even be mad.
n the thing is, adam has 3 pics total. a vending machine, a train, n somebody's elbow. i literally cant pay 47 on 3 pics. unless... i pay them all on THIS one.

choices.say: yes. 47 on the new pic. one a minute. flood him with so much nice he has to sit down.
no flood. one long comment. forty-seven words, and count every one.

them: stoppp. ur making me cry in my hair. (its flat so it absorbs it. thats new.) marisa would say the same thing. she said it at the salon last week when i held still for an hour: 'u look like urself when ur not working so hard.' i threw a comb at her.
ok but if i leave it UP, ppl will see the real me. n the real me has a rat tail comb n no top-8. i think. i think thats what im scared of. not the hair. the NO ONE COMMENTING.

choices.say: leave it up and comment back for real. the real you has a way better top 8 than you think.
tell lexi and misery. let your girls see it first and decide if it's a disaster.

them: ok. 1) lexi: 'OMG KITTY?? UR SO PRETTY?? (not that ur not usually) (u know what i mean)'. 2) misery: 'rawr XD u look like a wet kitten n i love it (i said it first)'. 3) holly (the hot topic girl): 'you got caught in the rain. relatable. you may keep your card.'
4) some guy named todd: 'Hi!! lovely photo!!' 5) paige: 'tilt next time. also, this is good.' they're ALL nice. why r they all nice. is it a trap. is the trap the nice.

effects.text: kittyxcore is looking at a pic of herself w/ flat hair. it has 11 comments. none r mean. she's checking again. =^.^=

choices.say: it isn't a trap. they're doing to you what you do to them: commenting back. go comment adam.
but you hate it. tell adam honestly and ask him to take it down.

them: ok. typing. 'cute pic!! pc4pc?' ...no. thats my 3-word default, n its fine for a stranger. its not fine for a guy who wrote 'friend #1' about me. i deleted it. i typed 'u look happy' n deleted that 2.
what do i say to a guy who has met 1 of 10,412 n picked me. i cant write 'thanks 4 the add.' he wrote that. its HIS line.

choices.say: say the true thing. 'best day of my summer.' it's not a default. it's a comment.
dm him first. tell him what scares you about the pic. then decide about the comment.

them: i wrote: 'friend #1 back at u. best day of my summer. i look like a wet kitten n id do it again. pc4pc (this 1 counts double).' i hit post. i didnt even check 4 typos. thats a first.

he answered in 3 seconds. 'THANKS 4 THE COMMENT!!!' n then, a second later: 'sorry, that was autopilot. i meant it. i meant THANK YOU. nobody ever commented a real thing before.' malten. i have to go sit on the bathroom floor.

effects.text: thanks 4 the comment!!! (sorry. autopilot.) i meant it. i printed it. it's the first one i ever printed. it's in my room, next 2 the vending machine pic. the pretzel was a 10. you're friend #1 and i'm saying it on purpose.

choices.say: he's your friend #1 too. say that in public, out loud, with a heart on it.
ask him to bring the hat next saturday. wear it. flat hair and all.

them: ok. i'm typing 2 him. 'adam can u take the pic down.' ...no thats mean. 'adam i look like a drowned hello kitty pillow.' ...he'll say thank u 4 the compliment. 'adam its not u its me.' ...i look 12 yrs old. who sends that.
i hate that i'm even asking. he finally had a thing 2 post that wasn't a vending machine. malten. he posted something REAL. n i want 2 delete it.

choices.say: be kind. ask him to swap it for one where the hat's on. he still gets 'friend #1 (met)'.
tell him the actual truth. you're scared of your own flat hair, not of him.

them: i told him. i wrote the whole thing. 'my hair is flat n i've never let anybody see it n im scared nobody will comment.' i hit send n put my face in the hello kitty pillow (the real one, not the one i look like in the pic).

he wrote back: 'i'll take it down if u want. i like it flat. i like it every way. its a lot of hair either way (i mean that as a compliment).' malten. he said 'i'll take it down' FIRST. before 'don't.' he said it first.

choices.say: keep it up. let him keep the best day of his summer. you lose a little hair-pride, he gets a lot.
ask for the hat swap. half the face, all the hat. keep the rest for when you're ready.

them: a hat swap. ok. its in the bag. he bought me a bucket hat, pink n black, 14.99 plus tax. he asked the girl at the kiosk 'is it casual or formal' n she said 'its a hat.' he said 'ok.' he tells that story like its a speech.

so we'd use the shot after, w/ the hat on, hair UNDER it, n he keeps the caption. 'friend #1 (MET!!!!)'. thats a good deal. thats a deal where nobody loses. except i kinda do. i just dont know which part.

choices.say: tell him you'll post a flat one yourself, someday, when you pick it. not him. you.
ask him to keep the original on his computer. just for him. he'll treasure it.

them: ok. i told lexi n misery. lexi said 'kitty ur not allowed 2 hate a pic where u look happy. thats the rule.' misery said 'rawr XD i love u i said it first.' they both said they'll comment adam's pic, which has NEVER had 3 comments before.
they're making a thing of it. lexi's making a banner. its in pink. ok. so now adam's getting a LOT of attention n i'm still the one who has to say the first nice thing.

effects.text: is gonna comment adam's pic. he has met kitty ONE time n it was the best thing he ever posted. (not that anyone asked about my pics) (nate) (not that its about that)

choices.say: go first. say it for real, in your own words. then your girls pile on.
all three of you flood him. 47 comments. make a festival out of it.

them: 47. on one pic. ok. its the weirdest repayment plan in the history of pc4pc n i'm doing it. i have 47 compliments. i have a list. 'ur hat is a 10.' 'ur elbow is photogenic.' 'the awning is a good awning.'
i'm starting now. comment 1: 'friend #1 deserves a parade.' n i'm doing 1 a minute so he can read them. wait, can he read them? his page is gonna look like a guestbook.

choices.say: yes, one a minute. different every time. no repeats. you can do 47.
forget the flood. one real comment beats forty-seven fast ones. go back to the real one.

them: comment 31: 'ur the only person who's ever asked if a hat is casual or formal.' comment 32: 'the pretzel was OURS.' adam is replying to every single one. n now hes writing 'please stop (im happy)' w/ a smiley. n im not stopping.
my fingers r cramping. 16 left. my mom just came in n said 'what is happening.' i said pc4pc. she said 'ok.' she brought me a glass of juice. shes the best.

effects.text: comment 31 of 47: ur the only person who ever asked a mall kiosk if a hat is casual or formal. i'm still thinking about it. pc4pc (REPAID IN FULL (n then some)). =^.^=

choices.say: finish it. sixteen more. it's the law and it's love.
stop at 31. write the last one big and real. one. the rest are in your pocket.

them: ok. its up. my comment, his pic, my flat hair. i'm leaving all 3. i'm putting my hand on my own hair, its so soft its like a wet mouse.

thanks, malten. i thought if i let anyone see it nobody would comment. instead i got 16 comments n a guy who printed one. i'm gonna keep the hat in the bag until next saturday. n then i'm gonna wear it. n then i'm gonna leave my hair flat in the car on the way home. =^.^=

effects.text: kittyxcore commented back. one pic. 61 words. her hair is flat in it n shes leaving it up. marisa says 'finally.' pc4pc: PAID (this 1 counts double) =^.^= <3

KITTY ur hair is FLAT n ur SO pretty omg i cant. i printed the pic. i put it on my fridge. my mom said who's that. i said thats kitty, shes a rockstar. (nate hasnt commented my pics since aug but THIS isnt about that) (ok its a little about that)

kitty. a flat-hair photo. posted by choice. it's the most goth thing you've ever done. (don't repeat that.) (i have a reputation.) (it's still the truth.) you may keep your card. also bring the hat in, i'll put it on the display.
adam has met 1 of 10,412 friends. 1 is a number. it's his favorite number. he printed it. thanks 4 the add, kitty. (that's not autopilot.)

them: 47. DONE. his page looks like a parade n i feel like i'm gonna throw up from happiness. adam wrote 'thanks 4 the comment' 47 times in a row n then 'ok that was autopilot but also i meant every one.' i'm so tired. my fingers hurt. its the best pain ever.
pc4pc: PAID IN FULL. n a debt isn't a debt when u laugh the whole time. thanks 4 saying go big. i'd do it again. ...no i wouldn't. my wrist says no. =^.^=

effects.subject: PC4PC REPAYMENT: 47 COMMENTS (LIVE) =^.^=
effects.text: ok so. in august adam commented all 47 of my pics n I paid 3. last night I paid 47 on ONE pic in 47 minutes (44 owed + 3 interest). highlights: 'ur elbow is photogenic.' 'the awning is a good awning.' 'friend #1 deserves a parade.' pc4pc is a debt of love n I always pay. (late. very late.) go look. leave him a comment. he'll say thanks 4 the comment. it'll be real. -kitty =^.^= <3
adam just got 47 comments in 47 minutes from a person he met in real life. he'd like to say thanks 4 the comment. 47 times. he has typed it twice. it's going to be 47.
some people... did 47 comments in 47 minutes. some people took 3 days to reply to a pic. (it was me.) (my sidekick died.) (it's fine.)
rawr XD KITTY 47?? i said it first. (i said 'rawr' first, kitty said '47' first. fair.) im commenting back on that guys elbow right now. it IS photogenic. i hate that u were right.

them: ok. the hat pic is up, the hair is under it, the caption stays: 'friend #1 (MET!!!!)'. adam says 'thanks 4 the swap' like it was a gift. n i said ur welcome. n i didn't type pc4pc. its the first time i didn't.

the flat one is on his computer, in a folder, called 'friend #1'. he told me. he thought i'd be mad. i'm not mad. i'm a little sad n a little glad n those r both allowed. i'll post one on my own someday. n it'll be MY pick. not the weather's.

effects.text: kittyxcore is wearing a hat. its the right hat. the hair under it is flat n shes ok w/ that for now. 'for now' is a real thing. =^.^=
thanks 4 the swap!!! the new one is great!!! (i kept the old one. on my computer. just for me. in a folder called 'friend #1'. i hope that's ok. u can say no. i'll delete it. it's ok if u say no.)
rawr XD kitty u wore a hat to hide the flat hair?? thats ok. i hid under a hat for ALL of 8th grade. (i said it first.) (the hat was a beanie.) (in july.) ur gonna be ok. XD

hey malten. ok i did it. i posted 1 flat pic. its tiny. its the back of my head on a bench at the salon w/ marisa's hand in it. its my hair from behind. 4 comments already. nobody can see my face. but u can see my hair. ok. i can do this. baby steps =^.^=
